metadata.title_en_template: {{child_name}} and the Secret of the Starlit Dunes

pages.background_theme: Peaceful undulating desert sand dunes at dusk with warm lantern light and first evening star
pages.text_en_template:
Across the quiet golden dunes where gentle breezes blow,
Young {{child_name}} watched the twilight sky begin to softly glow.
A guiding lantern lit the sand with warm and steady light,
To lead the way into the realm of peace and starry night.
pages.text_ar_template:
فَوْقَ كُثْبَانِ الرِّمَالِ الذَّهَبِيَّةِ حَيْثُ يَهْدَأُ المَسَاءُ،
وَقَفَ {{child_name}} يَرْقُبُ الأُفُقَ حِينَ تَبْدَأُ الأَضْوَاءُ.
فَانُوسٌ دَافِئٌ يُضِيءُ الدَّرْبَ بِنُورٍ وَاطْمِئْنَانٍ،
لِيَفْتَحَ بَابَ الرِّحْلَةِ نَحْوَ سِحْرِ الكَوْنِ وَالأَمَانِ.

pages.background_theme: Lush oasis date palms, tranquil turquoise spring, and glowing fireflies beneath starry sky
pages.text_en_template:
Beside the cool and tranquil spring, the date palms whispered low,
While fireflies danced across the dark in golden, playful glow.
'Step gently here,' the waters sang, 'for every dream is sweet,
And wonder waits at every path where stars and desert meet.'
pages.text_ar_template:
عِنْدَ مِيَاهِ الوَاحَةِ العَذْبَةِ، هَمَسَتْ أَشْجَارُ النَّخِيلِ،
وَفَرَاشَاتُ النُّورِ تَرْقُصُ فِي اللَّيْلِ الجَمِيلِ.
قَالَتِ المِيَاهُ لِـ{{child_name}}: 'نَمْ هَانِئًا فِي كُلِّ حِينٍ،
فَالسِّحْرُ يَمْلَأُ الدُّنْيَا لِكُلِّ قَلْبٍ أَمِينٍ.'

pages.background_theme: Dreamy celestial clouds, luminous golden crescent moon, and sparkling starlight constellations
pages.text_en_template:
Higher than the tallest hill, where silver moonbeams glide,
{{child_name}} soared among the stars across the heavens wide.
Each constellation formed a map of courage, truth, and grace,
A sparkling crown of stardust light above the quiet place.
pages.text_ar_template:
أَعْلَى مِنَ القِمَمِ حَيْثُ نُورُ الهِلَالِ يَلْمَعُ،
حَلَّقَ {{child_name}} فِي فَضَاءِ النُّجُومِ حَيْثُ الأَحْلَامُ تَتَجَمَّعُ.
رَسَمَتِ الأَبْرَاجُ طَرِيقَ الشَّجَاعَةِ وَالطِّيبَةِ وَالسَّلَامِ،
تَهْدِي خُطَاكَ دَوْمًا نَحْوَ أَجْمَلِ المَرَامِ.

pages.background_theme: Warm arched bedroom window, soft billowing curtains, glowing lamp, and peaceful moon outside
pages.text_en_template:
Now tucked inside a cozy bed beneath a gentle beam,
{{child_name}} closed their sleepy eyes to catch a golden dream.
For through the night the desert rests beneath the moon above,
And wrapped inside each quiet page is endless warmth and love.
pages.text_ar_template:
وَفِي السَّرِيرِ الدَّافِئِ تَحْتَ سُكُونِ اللَّيْلِ الهَادِئِ،
أَغْمَضَ {{child_name}} عَيْنَيْهِ فِي حِضْنِ الأَمَانِ البَادِي.
فَاللَّيْلُ يَهْمِسُ بِلُطْفٍ: 'نَمْ يَا حَبِيبِي فِي سَلَامٍ'،
فَأَنْتَ نُورُ دَارِنَا وَأَغْلَى مَا فِي الأَيَّامِ.
